ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated in distal regions; estimated macro-level ratio of 1:4 white-to-black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate the central peduncle and inner lobe regions; high-intensity (white/grey) mottling is mapped to the distal 30% of both lobes; distinct high-contrast cluster on the left lobe distal tip contains internal low-intensity focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees, bisecting the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serration along the right lobe trailing edge with pixel amplitudes of 3-7; left lobe trailing edge displays lower frequency, smoother undulations toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to leading edges, terminating in upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (light brown/white) indicative of barnacle colonies localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible ectoparasitic/epibiotic colonization (barnacles) at both distal fluke extremities, creating distinct non-pigment textural irregularities.
